detail.longDescription:
The Optimizely breach is kind of funny to me. It’s a tool for showing people different versions of your site to see which one ‘’drives the most engagement’’, and it works by letting a third-party script rewrite your whole page for every visitor. This week that script turned 178 websites into crypto-theft traps.

Could’ve just made a good site with solid security, instead of handing the page to a third-party script to drive engagement.

I feel the same about Google Analytics.

#InfoSec #WebDev
